label: About
title: About Held Across the Green
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 18 recent saved-signal files and 1 captured links, then narrowed the page to 1 source windows around @gucci4mycat: A happy family. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Held Across the Green: Landscape painted tableau on flat turquoise-green: a large bent pale arm and peach hand cradle a gray pointed-eared companion beneath jagged ice-blue hair. Across a wide green interval, a smaller yellow-crested peach face pairs with a cobalt-cyan creature. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 1 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Cobalt garment fold bounded by cloudy white trim and the underside of a bent pale arm and A broad cobalt fold with cloudy white edges beneath a bent pale arm.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
